This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Kenobi I" /> [[Vidara Jurness]]<ref name="Dawn Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was a member of this species.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their green, scaly skin, as well as a small black tuft of hair extending from the tops of their heads.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> a member of this species,<ref name="Kenobi I" /> [[Vidara Jurness]],<ref name="Dawn Guide" /> worked as a member<ref name="Kenobi I" /> of the [[Black Mask]],<ref name="Dawn Guide" /> a small mercenary gang tasked by the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] to [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnap]] the [[Princess]] of [[Alderaan]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in order to lure the fugitive [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] out of hiding, a task they would temporarily succeed at, though Kenobi eventually rescued the princess, resulting in their leader, [[Vect Nokru]], being executed at the hands of the [[Grand Inquisitor]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]].<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in "[[Part I]]" of the limited television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']],<ref name="Kenobi I" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2022]]<ref name="Episode 1 Release">{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}}</ref>
